Substitution: the commit has no file named dit.decision_advice.v1.schema.json. Its
request and response schemas are copied instead.

Contract text: docs/architecture/BOT_BRAIN_STANDARD.md sections 6.3 and 6.5 at the same commit.

EXAMPLES.jsonl has five lines. Lines 1, 2 and 5 are dit.bot_event.v1 rows (decision, advice,
and a 6.6 chat row with structured fields only, never the text). Line 3 is an advice request
(dit.decision_advice.v1). Line 4 is the matching advice response, which has no schema field.
bot_event_v1.py omits lines 3 and 4 as not_bot_event.
